LanguageData.RR_Bond_Inspect: Company bearer bond. Face value {0} credits.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_Description:
COMPANY BEARER BOND
Face value: {0} credits.
Payable to the holder on presentation. Whoever has it owns it: there is no name on it and no record of who drew it. It hauls, stores, sells, burns and can be stolen like any other object, and that is the whole trade against leaving the money in the company account where nobody can touch it.
Select it and press Deposit to put the credits straight back into the account. Several bonds lying together can be combined into the fewest, largest notes of the same total. A designated credit beacon still banks everything within its reach in one go.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_Flavour: Heavy paper, intaglio printing, a serial number and the company seal. It is worth exactly what it says and nothing else about it matters.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_DepositDesc: Put this bond's credits back into the company account. The paper is consumed; there is no spent husk left behind.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_CombineDesc: Replace every bond lying within a few cells with the fewest, largest notes of the same total value. Anything below the smallest denomination goes back into the account rather than being rounded away.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NoCompany: There is no company account to move credits into.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NothingToCombine: There is only one bond here. Put two or more together to combine them.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_AlreadyCombined: These bonds are already the fewest notes their total can be paid in.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_PrintUnfunded: The company account cannot cover a {0}-credit bond.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_InvalidDenomination: That is not a company bond denomination.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_Unfunded: The company account does not hold that much.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NoMap: No map to place bonds on.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_NoneInRange: No company bonds are within the beacon's range.
LanguageData.RR_CreditBeacon_DesignateDesc: Treat this trade beacon as a company credit beacon. It will report the face value of every company bond within its range, and can bank them into the company account. Its ordinary trade behaviour is unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_CreditBeacon_BankDesc: Bank every company bond within range into the company account. {0} credits are in range. The bonds are consumed.
LanguageData.RR_Bond_WithdrawDesc: Draw credits out of the company account as a physical bearer bond. The account holds {0} credits. Bonds can be hauled, stored and stolen; the account cannot.
LanguageData.RR_Exchange_SellDesc: Sell every tradeable item within the beacon's range to the parent corporation for credits. {0} item(s) in range, worth {1} credits: {2} from odd goods (above market, because the corporation cannot source them anywhere else) and {3} from ordinary valuables (below market - traders pay better if you can wait for one). Company bonds in range are never sold.
LanguageData.RR_Exchange_Sold: Sold {0} item(s) to the company for {1} credits.
LanguageData.RR_Exchange_NothingInRange: Nothing in range can be sold to the company.
LanguageData.RR_Exchange_NoMap: There is nothing here to sell.
LanguageData.RR_Event_ValuablesExchanged: Sold {0} item(s) to the company for {1} credits.
